category: no-code scraper service with prebuilt and universal scrapers

free_tier.stated: pay-as-you-go with a monthly Free Tier per service, tiers resetting every 30 days: Google Maps 500 businesses, Google Maps reviews 500, Google Search 10 searches (pages), Universal AI Scraper 5 pages, among others. Google Maps results export as CSV, Excel, Parquet or JSON, most other services as CSV or XLSX. The terms require a payment method before the first use
free_tier.notes: each service is metered in its own unit (businesses, reviews, searches, pages, domains, images); no vocabulary term names a returned record

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: billed per returned record

retention.stated: an API response is available for 4 hours after the request completes; the free allowance resets every 30 days and does not accumulate
retention.notes: how long a file from a web-app task stays on the Tasks page is not stated

egress.terms: not applicable: result files and API responses

interface_detail: a REST API authenticated by an X-API-KEY header (reference at app.outscraper.cloud/api-docs), about 20 queries a second on average; a format parameter (csv, json, parquet) turns a request into an asynchronous web-app task; the same services run from the web app with no code
tooling: the web app at app.outscraper.com; the REST API; the outscraper-python SDK on GitHub
chaining: Prebuilt Google Maps, reviews, search and contact scrapers return structured records with no selector work; for arbitrary pages the Universal AI Scraper's free tier is 5 pages a month, so a general page reader carries that load

limits.value: Google Maps: first 500 businesses a month free, then USD 3 per 1,000 to 100k, then USD 1 per 1,000
Google Search: first 10 searches (pages) a month free, then USD 5 per 1,000
Universal AI Scraper: first 5 pages a month free, then USD 9 per 1,000 pages to 5k, then USD 7 per 1,000
a payment method is required before the first use; a new account may be asked to deposit USD 10 of credits
API average about 20 queries a second, varying by service and parameters
an API response is kept 4 hours after the request completes

binding_note: the free allowance is a few hundred records per service a month (5 pages for the universal scraper); past it every record is billed, so the monthly free tier runs out long before the API rate does

identity_cost.detail: an account is an email sign-up confirmed by a verification email (reported); the terms require a payment method before the first use, and credits can be added by credit card, PayPal or other methods; staff state a new account, or API use, may be asked to deposit USD 10 of credits. A marketing page states no credit card is required to start, which the terms contradict

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded; a new account, or several accounts from one email or IP, may be held until a USD 10 credit deposit
confidence_note: the allowances, prices and formats are read from Outscraper's pricing, product and API pages; the email sign-up step is a third-party report

notes: Confirmed as a no-code scraper service with a free tier, though the free tier sits behind a payment method. Free runs: no run or task count is stated; the allowance is per service per month (500 Google Maps businesses, 500 reviews, 10 Google searches, 5 universal-scraper pages, and others). Pages per run: no per-run cap is stated; the universal scraper's free tier is 5 pages a month in total. Export formats: CSV, Excel, Parquet and JSON for Google Maps; CSV and XLSX for most other services; csv, json or parquet from the API. Cheapest paid step: USD 3 per 1,000 Google Maps records.
